reading.body:
This facility in Riverside County has no operator on file, no published power specifications, and no website. The research record shows the registry was unable to identify a real operator from the bare facility name "IT" and a street address alone, exhausting available search tools without resolution. Without operator confirmation or published specifications, this location cannot be assessed for AI infrastructure relevance.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities on record, of which only 11 publish power capacity figures totaling 365 megawatts. This facility does not appear in the published capacity rankings because it has reported no power specification to the public sources this site reads.

Any assessment of this campus's role in AI scaling would require the operator to publish power and cooling specifications, PUE rating, or other facility details. Until those facts are public, this location remains an unmapped node in the infrastructure picture.
